title: The Code Example Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Real information from reliable public sources and official catalogs, fact-checked reference. Tested code snippets with language, dependencies, licenses, and expected output. The Code Example Database stores code snippets that are actually tested: each snippet records its language, dependencies with versions, license, and the expected output, and every snippet is executed during verification so broken examples never ship. The Signature side adds line-by-line explainers for the most-used snippets.
